description_expanded: SummaryThis bright and welcoming 30A vacation rental offers an ideal location, minutes from the beach and close to community amenities like 2 pools, a hot tub, sports courts, and scenic trails. Inside, enjoy a cozy living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bonus room for extra lounging space. With 4 spacious bedrooms, a screened-in porch, 4 bikes, and a BBQ grill, this home has everything you need for a memorable 30A getaway.SpaceLocation perks: NatureWalk Lilly Lane Beach Trail (0.5 miles), Seagrove Beach (2.3 miles), Seaside Central Square (2.9 miles), Grayton Beach State Park (4.1 miles), Rosemary Beach (13.2 miles) Interior: - Fully equipped kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, air fryer, blender, cooking utensils, tableware) - 6 Smart TVs with cable (55” in the living room) - Full-size washer and dryer - Free Wi-Fi - Central heating and A/C - 2,152 sq. ft. Exterior: - Screened-in porch (upper level) - Outdoor seating - 4 bikes - Gas BBQ - On-site parking for 3 vehicles (in the alley driveway) - Parking in front of house (first come, first served) Community: - Hot tub - 2 Pools (lap pool heated year-round, kids pool) - Playground - Dual pickleball/basketball court - Walking trail with fitness stops - Beach trail access Upper Floor: Bonus room, 3 bedrooms, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 full bathroom Main Floor: Living room, kitchen, dining room, 1 bedroom, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 half bath Nestled in the sought-after NatureWalk community, this inviting 4-bedroom retreat blends coastal charm with comfort, perfect for families and groups. The open main level includes a fully equipped kitchen with updated appliances, a large dining area for shared meals, and a cozy living room with plush seating and a Smart TV. Upstairs, a bonus room adds more space to relax, featuring a sleeper sofa and a second Smart TV for movie nights or downtime. Designed to host up to 12 guests, the home offers a peaceful master suite with a king bed, private en-suite bath, and walk-in closet, plus two additional king bedrooms and a bunk room with three twin beds. Outdoors, unwind on the screened-in porch, grill out with the gas BBQ, or hop on the bikes to explore the area. Community amenities, including two pools (one heated year-round), a hot tub, pickleball courts, and scenic walking trails, are just steps from your door. With Seaside, Grayton Beach State Park, and the popular 30A bike path only minutes away, this home makes an excellent base for your 30A escape!NeighborhoodNestled in the desirable NatureWalk community, this home combines coastal charm with modern convenience, surrounded by lush state parks, rare dune lakes, and just minutes from the white sands of Seagrove Beach. This peaceful area places you close to 30A favorites like Seaside, known for its pastel cottages, boutique shops, and iconic Airstream food trucks, as well as the scenic trails of Grayton Beach State Park. From this home, enjoy easy access to bike and walking trails that connect to nearby attractions, dining, and entertainment. Catch live music at The Hub, go dolphin-watching, or paddleboard on Western Lake. Just a short drive away, Camp Helen State Park offers fishing, kayaking, and scenic views of Lake Powell. From beach days to seafood dining, this location is the perfect gateway to experiencing the best of 30A.TransitLocated in the desirable NatureWalk community, this home is perfectly positioned for exploring 30A. Bicycles are a popular way to get around, and with 4 bikes included, guests have everything needed for easy exploration. Nearby attractions include Seaside and WaterColor, each about 10 minutes away, and Grayton Beach State Park, which is around 12 minutes by car. During peak summer, the free 30A Trolley provides convenient stops along the main route.AccessGuests will have access to the entire home and parking for up to 3 vehicles in the private driveway off the alley. Parking in front of the house is first come, first served. They can also enjoy a variety of community amenities, including a hot tub, 2 outdoor pools, a pickleball/basketball court, a playground, and a walking trail with fitness stations.NotesNO Commercial Vehicles, Trailers, RVs, or Vehicles over 240” are allowed per HOA guidelines.
